name: Eval run comparison shows both runs' values and their delta
description: SPEC-04 moved where the comparison opens from: AC-66 opens it from the eval dashboard's run list, not the agent editor's Evals tab (which no longer renders run history at all, AC-59). Selects the seeded Security Reviewer on /eval, selects its two seeded eval-suite runs (agent v1 → v2) and opens the comparison. Asserts on copy only the comparison dialog renders — the compared versions, both recall values and the computed delta (AC-66) — not on the URL or the dialog's mere existence.
